instructions: STEP 1: Download classes.txt from https://github.com/xpwu95/IP102 - this is the canonical IP102 class index-to-name mapping.
STEP 2: Print your trained model's actual class_names / class_indices (e.g., from your training generator or the Kaggle 'rtlmhjbn/ip02-dataset' folder names) IN ORDER.
STEP 3: For each index 0-101, fill training_label with your model's folder/label name, and canonical_ip102_name with the matching classes.txt entry.

STEP 4: Only mark mapping_status as VERIFIED once both names have been checked to refer to the same pest (folder names on Kaggle re-uploads sometimes differ in spelling, ordering, or number of classes from the original IP102).
STEP 5: Once canonical_ip102_name is confirmed, create or link the matching record in pest_database.json and fill canonical_database_id here.
WARNING: Do not assume index order matches between your Kaggle dataset and the original IP102 repo without checking - re-uploads have been known to reorder or rename classes.
